editorial.blurb: Yvolina's crafts exceptional tamales with tender masa and bold fillings, but the real draw is their house-made mole—three varieties that locals rave about enough to take home by the jar.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask your server to let you taste the mole sauces before ordering (they'll let you sample); the caperino mole is a hidden gem. Note their 11am–6pm hours don't accommodate a dinner crowd, so plan accordingly.
signatureDishes: Quinoa and Lentils with Green Mole
